0.3.3.name: animate
0.3.3.description: Takes in a Node id and a property and linear interpolates that value towards the new specified value.

n_property.description: The property you want to animate (e.g., 'transform_position', 'transform_scale', or 'alpha').

target_id.description: The id of the node instance the animation is applied to.

end_value.description: The final target value to reach by the end of the animation.

easing.description: The easing curve name. Defaults to 'linear' if not passed.
